workspace.title: AI workshop
workspace.subtitleNoPlan: Build your plan by chatting with the agent or describing it all at once.
workspace.subtitleWithPlan: Refine your plan via conversation or regenerate it from a complete prompt.

chat.bannerTitleNoPlan: Guided mode — the agent asks the right questions
chat.bannerNoPlan: The agent will ask you a few questions to understand your project, then click Generate plan when it has enough information. You can also type go to force generation.
chat.bannerWithPlan: Ask the agent to add, rename, reorder or delete phases / steps / sub-steps. Your changes preserve the existing plan and can be undone from history. To start over, use the Quick prompt tab.

prompt.bannerTitleNoPlan: Describe your project all at once
prompt.bannerTitleWithPlan: Full regeneration — the current plan will be replaced
prompt.bannerNoPlan: The more precise it is (what, how, scope, constraints), the better the generated plan. You can then refine it via chat.
prompt.bannerWithPlan: Generates a plan from scratch from your prompt. All existing phases / steps / sub-steps will be deleted. To edit the plan without breaking everything, use the Conversation tab instead.
prompt.placeholder: Ex: AI note-taking web app. Quick capture, auto-generated tags, folder summaries. Stack React + FastAPI + Postgres. MVP shippable in 3 weeks.
prompt.duration: ⏱ Generation usually takes 30 s to 2 min depending on project size.

regenerateConfirm.title: Regenerate the plan?
regenerateConfirm.message: A plan already exists. All current phases, steps and sub-steps will be replaced. This action can be undone from chat history.

agentsPanel.title: Agents
agentsPanel.subtitle: Each agent has a declared role and explicit limits. Read-only.
